name: Armageddon: My Girlfriend Likes Versace
source:
This is troublesome, you ruined your last good pair of boots fighting off zombies. You need to get a new pair, but you can’t do it alone, so you have no choice but to convince this poor ex military personnel to go with you. 

[From [url=https://aalisblue.itch.io/armageddon-my-girlfriend-likes-versace]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这下可麻烦了，你在击退丧尸时把最后一双好靴子给穿报废了。你急需弄一双新靴子，可单枪匹马实在应付不来，于是别无选择的你只好设法说服眼前这位倒霉的退伍军人陪你走一遭。

[摘自[url=https://aalisblue.itch.io/armageddon-my-girlfriend-likes-versace]itch.io[/url]]
